instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive buttons, links, inputs, size chips, and product cards have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='explore-collection-btn', data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').
Use standard React .js files in src (not .tsx).
Integrate Three.js / @react-three/fiber or direct HTML5 Canvas floating gold particle animation for smooth performance across devices.
Implement Sonner toasts for notifications like 'Added to Bag', 'Wishlist updated', 'Order Placed'.
Ensure the gold headers use rich 3D drop-shadows and metallic gradient text.
Keep header background non-transparent (use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#080708]/85).
Make Razorpay modal interactive with smooth step progression and confirmation receipt animation.
Ensure WhatsApp floating button works directly using window.open('https://wa.me/919999999999?text=...') link.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
